# System Design Numbers

> Latency numbers, availability tables, traffic formulas, and ten worked capacity estimations. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Cheat sheets

- [Common estimation mistakes](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/cheat-sheets/common-mistakes.md): Most wrong estimates come from a small set of errors.
- [Estimation method](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/cheat-sheets/estimation-method.md): A back-of-the-envelope estimation follows the same five steps for every system.
- [System design numbers on one page](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/cheat-sheets/one-page.md): Every table from this repository in condensed form, for a final review.
- [Rounding rules](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/cheat-sheets/rounding-rules.md): Estimation by hand is practical only with rounded numbers.

## Worked estimations

- [Estimation: chat messaging](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/chat-messaging.md): A chat service delivers short messages between users in real time and stores the history.
- [Estimation: notification system](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/notification-system.md): A notification system sends push messages, emails, and text messages on behalf of other services.
- [Estimation: photo sharing](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/photo-sharing.md): A photo sharing service stores uploaded images and shows them in feeds and profiles.
- [Estimation: rate limiter memory](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/rate-limiter-memory.md): A rate limiter rejects requests from a client that exceeds an allowed rate.
- [Estimation: ride-hailing location updates](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/ride-hailing-location-updates.md): A ride-hailing service must know where every active driver is, so that it can match riders with nearby cars.
- [Estimation: social feed](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/social-feed.md): A social feed shows each user recent posts from the accounts they follow.
- [Estimation: typeahead](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/typeahead.md): Typeahead, also called autocomplete, suggests complete queries while a user is still typing.
- [Estimation: URL shortener](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/url-shortener.md): A URL shortener stores a mapping from a short key to a long address and redirects visitors.
- [Estimation: video streaming](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/video-streaming.md): A video streaming service stores uploaded videos and delivers them to viewers.
- [Estimation: web crawler](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/estimations/web-crawler.md): A web crawler downloads pages, extracts their links, and repeats the process to keep a copy of the web current.

## Numbers

- [Availability nines](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/availability-nines.md): Availability is the share of time a system answers requests correctly, written as a percentage.
- [Component capacity](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/component-capacity.md): An estimate ends with a count of machines, and that count needs an assumption about what one machine can handle.
- [Latency numbers](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/latency.md): Latency is the time between starting an operation and receiving its result.
- [Network and bandwidth](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/network-and-bandwidth.md): Bandwidth is the amount of data a network link carries per second.
- [Powers of two and data sizes](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/powers-of-two-and-data-sizes.md): Storage and memory are counted in powers of two, while traffic is counted in powers of ten.
- [Storage and object sizes](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/storage-and-object-sizes.md): A storage estimate is a count of objects multiplied by the size of one object.
- [Time conversions](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/time-conversions.md): Requirements are stated per day or per month, while capacity is planned per second.
- [Traffic formulas](https://github.com/design-gurus/system-design-numbers/blob/main/numbers/traffic-formulas.md): Traffic estimation converts a count of users into requests per second.
